summary: This Layer 1B pass expands the US-listed universe around the AI optical interconnect and compound-semiconductor epitaxy tool chain. The clearest direct public exposures are optical-component and laser suppliers that benefit from 800G/1.6T datacenter demand, plus a narrower underfollowed equipment supplier, Veeco, whose MOCVD and related deposition tools sit upstream of photonics and compound-semiconductor capacity. Coherent and Lumentum are reference leaders because their AI datacenter optics exposure is visible and now high-attention. MACOM is a direct component supplier for 1.6T optical connectivity and lasers. Veeco is the best fit for the underfollowed chokepoint lane because the node thesis specifically concerns specialized epitaxy/deposition tool capacity rather than only optical-module vendors. This is research support only, not a recommendation.
